interpretation: Each table partitions elapsed guest time; nested loader/validation/descriptor/provider/U32 tables must not be summed.
Device wait is ACK end to COMPLETE start, including modeled media and device processing, not measured pure rotation.
Wire transmission can overlap CPU service; outside-transaction time includes scheduling and other Tasks.
Phase values from instruction markers have finer resolution than the existing 20 ms VBI samples.
Accurate GENERIC57600 floppy timings apply; this does not characterize a flash-backed SIO device or physical hardware.
recommended_next_slice: Parse provider entries once per load, match all imports against that pass, and preserve full manifest, duplicate/missing provider and contract checks. No ABI or compiler change; remeasure before claiming savings.
